enchantments.tooltip: Electric Absorption +16%: Passive: 16% Enhancement Bonus to Electric Absorption. (Absorption reduces damage from an element by a percentage, after resistance have been taken into account.)
Dexterity +4: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +4 Enhancement bonus to Dexterity.
Insightful Dexterity +1: This item makes the wearer more nimble and dexterous, granting a +1 Insight bonus to Dexterity.
Parrying +1: +1 Insight bonus to Armor Class, +1 Insight bonus to Saves.
